body fluid color change (urine, sweat, saliva, tears → yellow, orange, red, or brown) = common but harmless
also rash, bleeding problems, kidney failure; discolors contact lenses
inhibits DNA-dependent RNA polymerase; bactericidal to all populations of organisms
potent P450 inducer → many DIs: ⇣effect of OCPs, quinidine, corticosteroids, warfarin, methadone, digoxin, PO hypoglycemics; aminosalicylic acid may ⇣ RIF absorption
: in pts taking protease inhibitors, NNRTIs
active TB: 4-mo regimen = INH, rifapentine, PZA, moxifloxacin
rifamycin (like RIF): induces hepatic CYP3A4 → ⇡metabolism of dexamethasone (impaired cortisol suppression on DST)
, drug-induced lupus, rash, abd pain, ↑AG acidosis, cytochrome P450 inhibition
BBW: severe, sometimes fatal hepatitis; USU w.in first 3mo of tx
bactericidal vs actively growing intra- + extracellular mTB
Clin Use: active pulm TB, TB meningitis, latent TB
pyridoxine 10mg PO QD = prophylaxis; 50–100mg PO QD = tx of neuritis
given w/ INH to prevent periph neuropathy
gout flares, joint aches; neuropathy ⍉a SE
MOA: converted to pyrazinoic acid → ⇣pH; disrupts mycobacterial membrane energetics in acidic environments; bactericidal to intracellular organisms
→ scotoma, color perception problems (red-green), visual chgs,
also ⇣ visual acuity, color blindness; optic neuritis reversible w/ d/c (rare @ 15mg/kg)
MOA: inhibits arabinosyl transferase → impaired mycobacterial cell wall synth; bactericidal (intra- + extracellular)
mainly used to prevent resistant mutants
Monitor: red-green color discrimination + visual acuity
Caution: kidney dz or if ophthalmologic testing ⍉feasible
